tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ع-د-ن (ʿ-d-n), 'to settle, dwell'. Adnān means 'settler'. Its root is ع-د-ن (ʿ-d-n). Adnan, the traditional ancestor of the northern Arabs. Adnan is a Arabic name meaning “Settler; one who settles”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
